mentions.name: GitHub issues/PRs iteration loop orchestrator
mentions.description: This tool orchestrates iteration loops based on GitHub issues and pull requests. The author describes it as the actual useful output of the project and plans to open-source it as well.
mentions.source_excerpt: The actual useful output is an iteration loop orchestrator based on GitHub issues/PRs which I have found a lot of fun to use. That'll also be open-sourced.
mentions.author: alex-moon
